block.title: Zero-axiom Rocq soundness proofs cover the Gallina middle-end optimizer
block.p: Six zero-axiom Rocq proof modules under nanofil/rocq/opt now prove soundness properties of the Gallina unchecked-IR middle-end optimizer directly against Ops.v, Values.v, and Semantics.v. Every proof compiles under pinned Rocq 9.1.1 without importing Runtime.v, and Makefile runs Print Assumptions across all 209 top-level declarations to require Closed under the global context.

OptAluProof.v proves that OptIr.eval_alu matches Nanofil.Ops.alu and Nanofil.Ops.additive_res across all 18 integer operations and proves that every Simplify.pure_op leaves memory untouched, never traps, and evaluates identically in any two memory states, isolating FloatToInt as the only pure operation that can return OpUB. SimplifyArithProof.v proves soundness for commutativity, comparison mirroring and negation, power-of-two shift and mask rewrites, all algebraic identities in apply_identity, narrow extension subsumption, boolean comparisons, additive and equality cancellation (including exact ptr_cap capability preservation at class p), and the top-level simplified dispatcher. SimplifyRebaseProof.v proves 32-bit signed range analysis, overflow-free 32-to-64 ext(uw) and ext(sw) widening in lin_op, commutative value-numbering keys, capability-preserving address rebasing in rebased_op, boolean result recording, and branch folding in fold_jump.

SimplifyCfgProof.v proves that the worklist fuel S (length roots + edge_sum) in dead_code always reaches dependency closure, that only pure removable definitions are deleted, that prune_blocks preserves every reachable block, and that bypass_one and absorb_one preserve entry blocks. AliasProof.v proves alias_facts_sound for exact 64-bit modular displacements and exact pointer capability preservation. CopyLocalProof.v proves copy-value soundness, copy-chain normality and domain coverage, rank-justified trivial-phi worklist soundness, equivalence between OptCopy.reps_block_map and Copy.reps_block, the 4096-byte local-storage budget bound, and in-bounds byte access for every rewritten local_load and local_store.

Mechanization also surfaced five implicit preconditions and recorded kernel-checked counterexamples for each: a self-mapping cache breaks copy_chain normality unless cached endpoints are normal; mutually circular phis break non-well-founded phi consistency without a strictly decreasing rank witness; bool_result matches ext(s) unless floating-point widening is excluded by typing; folding a same-target branch requires its condition to evaluate; and an unchecked self-comparison at pointer result class changes the word constructor from WInt 1 to WPtr.

claim.p: The nanofil-frontend Nix check builds make -C rocq/opt proofs, verifies that all 209 top-level declarations across the six proof modules are closed under the global context with zero axioms, and passes web/rocq/tests/parse.sh grammar round-trip compilation across all 34 .v files in rocq/opt and rocq/frontend.
